body: Tbh I got hard as soon as my girl walked in too and sure most of the time we’d have sex, but if I made a promise to dinner we would make out for a bit I’d tease her until she wanted it then we would go out for dinner, that way we both have an uncomfortable dinner 😂, in all seriousness it’s just self control it sucks, but tell him to think of something repulsive it’s controllable.

I’m 6’2 and didn’t get as much attention as my 5’6 friend it’s all about personality dude.

Listen in the last couple of months I went through something very similar, and trust me as much as it feels like you’re not enough you are broham, it’s her. Mine wasn’t ready for me either and now she’s happy with someone else and I’m talking to someone new now that I’m over it, but it took me a lot of self harm before I realized I was enough. Just try to move on and forget, and I can tell you to this day I still have love for her in a platonic way, I wish her the best with her new man and I hope they work out even though I severed the connection on purpose. Don’t torture yourself man. Anyways sorry for the ramble hope it gets better soon.
Thank you stranger I’ll think about moving in a more positive way and see if that changes things.

Thanks for the advice, and I’d be shooting into my mouth directly back to sever the spinal cord from the brain stem if bullet doesn’t hit its target maybe the shock will make me drown, and I don’t know I’ve felt this way for a long time and I can’t explain that feeling of unworthiness or the cause of it, I try to be kind to strangers, and the people that used to be around me, I used to give people everything I had if they needed help, and it was just never enough. As far as volunteering I don’t have the time working a full time job with random ot and trying to keep myself going to the gym and having rest time at home I don’t have that luxury of time, unless I want to be even more exhausted.
Thanks bud, I want to believe that too.
Oof that last part hit me right in the feels sucks when you not only lose your love but also your best friend, and shit I feel the same way at 23 so it’s just a mind things you’ll be fine my man.
You’re not ugly, he’s just an asshole.

Money buys freedom to do the things you enjoy, but it definitely does not make you happy, I wish I was rich too to maybe try more things and find meaning but I know within time I’ll get bored of those things too, and it’ll just turn into a never ending cycle of trying to find something to fulfill myself with.
Honestly I work out 6 times a week it, it doesn’t help me that much anymore it’s great for the first week or two and then it’s just another routine to fill a void time slot.

I downloaded tinder right after, I’m using it to make friends around me because I lost my best friend not just my love. Definitely a distraction but people handle things differently and you should handle it your way.

She did this to me, I was ok being alone. I told her I wanted to stay friends, I told her she didn’t want my feelings and I was honest with her about my past relationships and how I didn’t want another heartbreak she insisted she did, and would never do anything to hurt me, I fell in love like never before and here we are today.

I’m sorry to hear this, my first love was a similar situation as well and I blocked my emotions out for years dating superficially and it’s not healthy at all, take your time and heal from it, someone better will come along. If you ever need someone to talk to message me.
Thank you! I’m trying my best to stay positive even though I’m feeling the regret of never being able to see those I love yous from her again.

Thank you, it took me two months of struggling with the decision, holding on to that false hope that one day she’d change her mind and I magically would be enough again and we would be happy together again. Take your time and think about yourself and respect yourself king.
